q: summarize the employee handbook leave policy
answer:
The leave policy requires employees to follow specific procedures for requesting leave, with different approval requirements based on the duration of the leave. Sick leaves are entitled but not carried forward, and must be supported by a medical certificate if taken for more than two days. For other types of leave, approvals from reporting managers are needed, with varying notice periods depending on the length of the leave. The policy also encourages employees to take time off for work-life balance.

Sources: (Samta-Employee Handbook April_2026.pdf)
